annotations.text: Simulator: the Duo ships only with Xcode 27.1 (RC); this Mac has 27.0. The download needs an Apple Developer sign-in, so these boards are drawn from Apple's HIG, the developer guide and the Tech Talks, not from simulator screenshots.
My pick to start with: B (desk console) and A (book with the evidence page). Both reuse parts we already have and neither works on a regular iPhone.
